Tokenomics (Serious & Sustainable): •  Total Supply: 88.8 million (symbolic of infinity + balance). •  Deflationary burns on Insight minting. •  Multi-chain (high-speed L2s). •  Strong focus on privacy, ethics, and data sovereignty.
